note: Top-level floors = PCB-Calculator / pool standard at 35 µm final copper: 100 µm track and space, 0.2 mm drill, 0.4 mm via pad, 100 µm annular ring (all stated explicitly on the technical-options and design-parameters pages). min_drill_mm uses the 0.2 mm 'Drills' inclusion (the drills page says 'Drilling 0.1mm' smallest but 'Holes with Ø smaller than 0.2mm have a low machining speed (= surcharge)'). Solder-mask clearance uses the PCB-Calculator figure 75 µm (design-parameters page gives 50 µm green). Silkscreen: 150 µm is the 'optimum font width' for 1.2 mm font height, not a stated hard minimum. Edge clearance = conductor/pad to milling edge 200 µm (scoring edge 500 µm). board_thickness_mm lists only the pool thicknesses (1.55, 1.0); calculator range 0.5-3.2 mm. Copper weights 1/2/3 oz = 35/70/105 µm final outer copper offered in the calculator. impedance_control true = impedance control on request/extra charge (+/-10 % or +/-5 %); the free defined buildups do not include impedance control.

stackups_note: Four 'Defined layer buildups' (free of charge, also in pool). Every layer thickness and every Ԑr is printed in the PDF and the same figures appear in the four PNG images on the impedance-examples page; images were viewed to place each Ԑr on its layer (PDF text extraction scrambles the column order). Header note: 'Only nominal values'; 'Specified prepreg thicknesses: after pressing, at approx. 80% copper utilisation on the inner layers.' Outer copper is printed 'Cu 18µm + plating' with 35µm in the thickness column, so thickness_mm 0.035 is the plated value and weight_oz/copper_outer_oz 0.5 is the 18 µm base foil. No 2-layer stackup with Ԑr is published, and no 1.6 mm 8-layer (8L-01 is 1.7 mm). Order: 4L-01 (1.6), 6L-01 (1.6), 8L-01 (1.7), then 4L-02 (1.0). The default 'variable layer buildup' (FR4 1,55 mm, prepregs/cores vary with availability) has no published stackup. Separate Rogers 4350B/FR4 hybrid buildup PDF exists but was not transcribed (RF material).
